messages:
tara_sre: Heads up — sharp queue growth on the proxy in us-east around 1924000000, embeddings and /v1/stream endpoints showing 10x wait and 502s ~3%. Not from a deploy. Looks like a probing/spike from a small set of ASNs.

mike_ops: on it. Are logs showing source IP distribution? any long-lived connections?

tara_sre: Logs show many long-lived TLS connections and repeated partial POSTs. Top ASNs: 134567, 20345, 65521. SYN/RST pattern + small payloads.

security_emma: tagging as security incident. We should contain first, then collect forensic logs. Ensure edge audit logs are preserved and S3 objects encrypted with CMK remain accessible — I need a list of the affected object keys for later KMS decrypt audit.

mike_ops: propose emergency mitigation: 1) edge per-IP rate limit -> 100 rps 2) per-ASN block for listed ASNs 3) add proxy connection timeout to 10s to drop long-held sockets. Start with blocking ASN 134567 and 20345.

ops_ben: +1 to connection timeout. If we drop too aggressive we risk hurting large users behind NATs — prefer per-ASN first.

support_ale: I'll start drafting a customer advisory for tenants seeing failures. Need affected customer IDs (we'll map IPs->tenant).

mike_ops: rolling WAF rule now. snippet:```json
{"action":"block","conditions":[{"field":"asn","values":["134567","20345"]}],"meta":{"incident":"1924000000"}}
``` Applying edge rate-limit:```yaml
edge_rate_limit:
  scope: ip
  limit: 100
  window: 1s
  header_on_block: X-RW-BLOCK
```

deploy-bot: WAF rule 9887 deployed to edge-pop us-east-1 in 28s; config id=cfg-1924000000-01

tara_sre: after WAF push + rate-limit + reduced timeout: queue depth down ~75%, 502s down to 0.9%. Seeing some collateral 429s on a handful of customers.

devex_eli: can we get a list of the customers who hit 429s so we can proactively message them? I'll hold advisory until we have the list.

mike_ops: mapping IPs->tenant now. Will upload encrypted CSV to secure-bucket path s3://redwood-incident-uploads/1924000000/tenants.csv.enc — encrypted with incident CMK.

security_emma: grant temporary RBAC role incident_read_192400 to support_ale and security_emma for 4 hours to access the object. Audit logs must capture KMS decrypt calls.

oncall_bot: Incident created INC-2026-1924 by tara_sre at 1924000021

support_ale: received the list after RBAC grant, compiling customer draft now. No PII in file, just tenant_id + region + observed rps.

mike_ops: follow-up: add a lightweight edge rule to return Retry-After: 30 for 429s so clients back off. Also add header X-RW-INC=1924000000 to all mitigated responses so logs are searchable.

security_emma: capture full edge access logs for window 1923999900-1924003600 and move to cold-storage. Also start a vuln triage ticket: is there any application-level vector that lets the clients hold connections open? Label as triage-192400.

ops_ben: creating runbook action items: 1) update WAF-asn-list automation 2) add ASN-based telemetry to console 3) tune connection timeout thresholds per region.

devex_eli: customer advisory ready except we need an ETA for rollback of rate limits. Mike, what's expected timeline?

mike_ops: keep rate limits and ASN blocks for 4 hours, then re-evaluate. We'll gradually relax if telemetry stays stable.

tara_sre: monitoring looks stable. Will open follow-up postmortem: include root-cause (probing botnet from listed ASNs), containment steps, KMS/audit notes, and customer comms copy.

security_emma: after-action: ensure KMS CMK key policy records which principals did decrypt; add a permanent alert to detect sudden ASN concentration > 80% for an endpoint. Also schedule RBAC review so incident_read roles are time-limited and logged.

support_ale: customer advisory sent to affected tenants at 1924000850: "We detected elevated traffic impacting response times; mitigation applied; no data exposure. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem."

mike_ops: closing mitigation at 1924000980 (start relaxing per-IP limit to 250 rps, maintain ASN blocks for monitoring).

deploy-bot: edge-config cfg-1924000000-01 rolled back to allow higher per-ip limits at 1924000985

tara_sre: incident moving to monitoring. Postmortem ticket: PM-192400-queue-starvation created and assigned to tara_sre. Action items: longer audit-log retention 90d, add ASN-based runbook, automate tmp RBAC roles, update docs for KMS decrypt audit.

security_emma: thanks team. Good containment. We'll sync tomorrow for the full postmortem.
